claims.quote: Living as we do in the closing year of the twentieth century, enjoying the blessings of a social order at once so simple and logical that it seems but the triumph of common sense
claims.description: By the year 2000 society has been reorganized into a simple, logical social order.
claims.stated_time: the closing year of the twentieth century

claims.quote: the present organization of society is, in its completeness, less than a century old
claims.description: A complete transformation of the social and industrial system takes place within the twentieth century.

claims.quote: These statements seem so absurd on their face, especially when I add that I am a young man apparently of about thirty years of age, that no person can be blamed for refusing to read another word of what promises to be a mere imposition upon his credulity.
claims.description: A man born in 1857 is alive and still young in the year 2000 after being suspended through time.

claims.quote: The great enthusiasm of humanity which overthrew the older and brought in the fraternal society was not primarily or consciously a Godward aspiration at all.
claims.description: A humane mass movement overthrows the old order and establishes a fraternal society.

claims.quote: The corner-stone of our state is economic equality
claims.description: A state founded on guaranteed economic equality for all citizens.

claims.quote: Nowadays, as life advances toward its close, instead of being shadowed by gloom, it is marked by an access of impassioned expectancy
claims.description: In the future society, old age and approaching death are met with joyful expectancy rather than gloom.

claims.quote: It startled me to read the passage in which Edith shows the musical schedule to Julian West, and tells him to choose which selection he wishes to have brought through the air into the music room.
claims.description: Music is piped on demand to the home over telephone wires (a commentator noting the book's prediction).

claims.quote: Much which is now established in Soviet Russia bears at least a likeness to the industrial army visioned in this prophetic book.
claims.description: An industrial army organizing national labor (a commentator describing the book's prediction).

claims.quote: the equal share allotted to all persons in the products of industry, or the public income, on the same ground that men share equally in the free gifts of nature, like air to breathe and water to drink
claims.description: A nationally organized industry gives every person an equal share of the public income (a commentator describing the book's scheme).
